stories.title: Bond crisis worsens! US 30-year Treasury yields surge to highest level since 2004. What lies ahead?
stories.summary: The US bond selloff intensified as the 30-year Treasury yield hit its highest level since 2004, while the 10-year yield reached a post-financial-crisis high. Strong US economic data, rising inflation concerns, elevated government debt and higher oil prices have fuelled expectations of further Federal Reserve rate hikes, pressuring global bond markets.

Market participants anticipate a repo rate hike on October 7 due to economic conditions.

stories.summary: Reliance Industries plans to raise around Rs 10,000 crore ($1.04 billion) via 10-year rupee-denominated bonds at a 7.90% annual coupon. Following a recent Rs 12,000 crore 5-year debt issuance, the oil-to-telecom major aims to secure funding ahead of the RBI’s October 7 monetary policy meeting amid favourable local yields.

stories.title: Rupee declines to one-week low as oil rally fans global rate hike worries
stories.summary: The Indian rupee has fallen to its lowest point in a week, fueled by escalating oil prices and inflation worries. Although dollar sales by government banks helped mitigate the decline against the dollar, emerging market currencies are facing intense pressure. Similarly, U.S. Treasury yields have hit multi-year peaks, contributing to the challenging landscape.
